jobs.title: Reliability Engineer (Rolling Stock)
jobs.description:
Atlas Rail Maintenance keeps 120 locomotives and multiple-unit trains running for passenger and freight operators.

What you'll do
• Analyse failure data from our CMMS and calculate MTBF, MTTR and availability per fleet and per subsystem.
• Run FMEA workshops with depot technicians and update preventive maintenance intervals.
• Build Weibull models of component lives to support overhaul and spare parts decisions.
• Lead root cause analysis of repeated failures and follow corrective actions.

Requirements
• Engineering degree in mechanical, industrial or reliability & maintenance engineering (fresh graduates welcome).
• Hands-on FMEA / FMECA practice.
• Weibull analysis or other life data analysis.
• Working knowledge of a CMMS such as SAP PM or IBM Maximo.
• Fluent French and good English.

Nice to have
• Reliability-centered maintenance (RCM).
• Python or Power BI for reliability dashboards.
• Experience in railway or another heavy industry.
